source: Claude Report 004, 1000 seeded runs, 250 per policy

policy.anti_exploit: estimate villain shove frequency from observed public hands only, with shrinkage to personality priors; call when modeled hand equity vs plausible ranges supports price, risk and tournament context; no omniscience or quota

ai_specs.all_in_response_model: equity >= pot_odds + calibrated_risk_premium; multiway equity, opponent hand range, ICM-like survival pressure, and player/AI exposure biases considered

boss.net_gain: final_stack - entry_stack, snapshot at first posting of blinds; exclude unrelated shop transfers

tests.samples: at least 1000 runs per policy using shared seeds; 10 independent seed batches
tests.compare: maniac success should fall materially relative to 38.8%; disciplined policies should improve relative to maniac (directional target, not fake certainty)
checks: no blanket call shoves outside modeled pot odds
rate uncertainty intervals and poker AI style stats
compare before/after on identical seed batches

last_claim: no global mercy probability change in P5; make pre-death relationship and outlook legible; reevaluate after real-player testing
